info.name: Veeam Backup for AWS public API 1.0 Agents Services API

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of services to return.

params.name: orderColumn
params.description: Sorts services by one of the service parameters.

params.name: orderAsc
params.description: Sorts services in the ascending order by the `orderColumn` parameter.

params.name: nameFilter
params.description: Filters services by the `nameFilter` pattern. The pattern can match any service parameter. To substitute one or more characters, use the asterisk (*) character at the beginning, at the end or both.

items.docs: The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/services` path allows you to get associated services for integration with Veeam Backup & Replication.
